mia (finance): Quick follow-up: postmortem showed a short duplicate-event window affecting ~2.1k invoices. Need owners for reprocess, PR, and support comms. Keeping it tight.

tony (eng-ml): RCA summary: a batching key change caused non-unique batch_ids during a producer restart at 2026-04-07T03:14Z. Duplicate writes for ~3m. I have a small repro script and a PR-ready fix (adds producer_instance_uuid to batch key).

kevin (eng-sre): Containment: paused auto-finalize and toggled the dedupe flag on the consumer fleet at 03:21Z. No new duplicates since. I'll schedule a 90m maintenance slot for the safe rollout.

rachel (platform): Reprocess plan: run a staged replay with idempotent merge, validate ledger hashes pre/post. SQL to find candidates I will run in staging:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, account_id, COUNT(*) events, SUM(token_delta) tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-04-07 03:10:00' AND '2026-04-07 03:20:00'
GROUP BY invoice_id, account_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND ABS(SUM(token_delta)) > 75
LIMIT 2500;
```

support-bot: Created ticket BIL-6110: "invoice-delta-reconcile". Uploaded affected-accounts CSV to s3://incidents/BIL-6110/affected.csv

mia (finance): Owners (please ack):
- @rachel (platform): run reprocess + validation (ETA 48h)
- @tony (eng-ml): merge PR + add regression test for restart/retry (ETA 36h)
- @kevin (eng-sre): rollout window + unfreeze checklist (ETA 12h)
- Finance: will approve credits after validation.

kevin (eng-sre): ACK. Scheduling 04/08 01:00-02:30 PT maintenance for canary -> full rollout if green.

tony (eng-ml): ACK. PR in 1.5h, will include integration test and metric `metering.duplicate_rate`.

rachel (platform): ACK. I'll post the staging reconciliation diff and an audit CSV before applying to prod.

mia (finance): Thanks. One request: keep customer comms minimal until we confirm adjustments. Support, please prepare a short notice template and a detailed postmortem draft. Will check back 09:00 PT tomorrow for progress. :white_check_mark:
